profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments

positions.title: Student Technician
positions.description:
Computer Hardware troubleshooting
Helpdesk type environment
Took help calls, also went out on ticketed troubleshooting projects
Helped image many computers with varied operating systems over deadline periods

positions.title: Projects Experience
positions.description:
Fundamentals of Data Modeling: High Level Data Modeling Project Group Leader
Interview a subject matter expert and develop a data model for the service that the expert explained in the interview.  This included developing context diagrams, ER Diagrams, Level 0 Diagrams, Primitive Process Modeling, and State Transition Diagrams. Group leader helps organize meetings and help each team member with checking over the work as well as generating their own diagrams.


Human Computer Interaction 2: Human Factors UI Development Group Organizer 
To develop a marketable UI for the general market.  This includes a variety of documentation including heuristic testing, design documents, hierarchical task analysis, and prototyping various stages of the UI in Adobe Flash.  Group organizer makes sure all assignments are handed in on time, give presentations and generate the documentation for the various stages of the project.; 
Worked as part of the Technology Services team for NTID.  Maintained the workstations and portable machines for a variety of staff and faculty in NTID.  The technician who works closely with other technicians in Technology Services and Client Services.  Responded to trouble tickets, posted in online databases, and contacted clients through a variety of mens: phone, emai, etc.  Managed multiple databases that included an inventory database and a database used to enable and configure network connections across campus as well as a database that was used to track resources and find problems in individual computers.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description:
Develop Powerpoints to explain business ideas
Learn AGILE program development and partake in an AGILE programming project
Interact with company database writing and running queries of varying degree.

positions.title: Student Computer Technician
positions.description: Worked in a team to maintain and repair of all the computers in high school.  Repair service tickets were submitted to the repair office, and student technicians would be sent out to trouble-shoot or repair the problem.  In contact with a variety of clients including students, teachers, and other staff.
